performance.verdict: Meta dark 2 days; pipeline shows zero opps despite 30 leads — intake is the real leak.

findings.text: Meta spend hit $0 on Sep 9–10 (channel_dark confirmed); 28-day avg CPL $46.95 but daily delivery is now fully stopped.
CPL fell 50.45% WoW to $46.95 with 22.22% more leads — efficiency gain is real but built on only $47.85/day average spend, well below $65–75/day SOW target.
3-day signal (Sep 7–9): leads 2,3,0 vs prior 3-day (Sep 4–6): 1,0,5 — flat to declining as spend collapsed from $94 to $40 to $0; trend is spend-driven, not creative-driven.
GHL shows 24 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments from 30 28-day leads — intake pipeline is completely broken; ads are not the bottleneck.
3 overdue SOW milestones as of Aug 31: extension with Marwan unsigned (gates next 3 months), SMS automation not live, Zoho Voice access not granted — all block performance infrastructure.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta delivery immediately — 2 zero-spend days are confirmed; verify billing/account status and reactivate 'Leads - August Re-Launch' at $65/day.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend dropped to $0 on Sep 9 and Sep 10, confirmed by the daily series; the sole active campaign 'Leads - August Re-Launch' is dark. Hamza/Hamdan to check account billing status and any policy flags today and restore spend to $65/day (SOW minimum). Success check: confirmed non-zero spend reported in platform by Sep 12.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake: 30 leads arrived in 28 days, 0 opportunities created — diagnose form-to-pipeline mapping failure before any budget increase.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 24 contacts and zero opportunities created against 30 Meta leads in the 28-day window — this is a confirmed intake mapping failure, not an ads problem. Nacer to audit the instant-form-to-GHL workflow and opportunity-creation trigger with Andrew by Sep 14. Success check: new leads from the restored campaign appear as created opportunities in GHL within 24 hours of arrival.

suggestions.text: Watch CPL after Meta reactivation for 3 full days; $46.95 CPL efficiency gain may not hold at full $65–75/day spend level.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL improved 50.45% WoW to $46.95 at a reduced $47.85/day average spend — it is unclear whether this efficiency holds when budget is restored to the $65–75/day SOW target. Do not scale beyond $65/day until 3 consecutive days of data at full spend are available. Re-check CPL on Sep 15.
